evidence_excerpts: We develop a unified and uniform account of grounding and essence, one which understands them both in terms of a generalized notion of identity examined in recent work by Fabrice Correia, Cian Dorr, Agustín Rayo, and others.
text: Grounding and essence can both be analyzed in terms of generalized identity, yielding a unified and uniform account of how the two metaphysical notions interact.
